$comment: Event schema. The brief asked for 'the five defined events' but did not enumerate them, so this is a proposal by this session and is labelled as such on the site (see FLG-009).
provenance: proposed by arena-04112b09 on 2026-11-20; not an existing standard

storage.default: browser-local (sessionStorage + a rolling localStorage counter); nothing is transmitted while site.config.json measurement.endpoint is null
storage.opt_in: aggregate POST of the object below to an endpoint the operator hosts; see tools/collector.sample.mjs
compliance: Sub-tags may never be associated with a specific end user, and tags must not be dynamically assigned per visitor - SRC-02 §2(b)
Clicks and impressions must not be artificially generated, by robot or software - SRC-02 §6(s)
Cookie/pixel use by the site and third parties must be disclosed - SRC-02 §3(e)

events.name: page_view
events.why: Denominator for everything else; tells us which template earns reading.

fields.v: epoch seconds, client clock, not used for identity

events.authorized_source_for_ledger: own counter only; Search Console 'impressions' is the external cross-check

events.name: guide_open
events.why: Separates a landing click from a reader who started a guide - the difference between curiosity and intent.
events.trigger: first content intersection past 40% viewport, or direct navigation to /guides/**

events.name: outbound_click
events.why: The only conversion proxy this site can honestly collect; the brief's primary metric candidate (SG-15).
events.trigger: click on an a[href] whose host is a store host; recorded, then the browser navigates normally
events.hard_rule: no preventDefault, no interstitial, no redirect hop - a Redirecting Link disqualifies the purchase (SRC-02 §2(e))

fields.v: destination host as written in href
boolean - catches an untagged link in the wild
boolean - catches a missing sponsored value

events.authorized_source_for_ledger: own counter (clicks) is a floor, not a truth: Amazon's own report is what counts

events.name: product_intent_check
events.why: Makes the register's incompleteness visible as work, not as a footnote: every time a row is still unresolved, that is a measured open item.
events.trigger: on load of the Picks page when any row has status 'unresolved'; and when an operator re-runs npm run verify:intent

events.name: editorial_decision
events.why: The suggestions board only improves the site if accepted/rejected paths are recorded; this event is that record, exported as markdown.
events.trigger: a decision row is changed on /suggestions/ and the operator exports it

fields.v: list of Q-nn ids now answered
